gloss: New Year's Day; the morning of January 1st

definitions.gloss: New Year's Day; the morning of January 1st
definitions.explanation: Strictly refers to the morning of January 1st, though in modern usage it is often used to mean all of January 1st. The character {旦|たん} originally means dawn or morning.

examples.japanese: {元旦|がんたん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{初詣|はつもうで}→初詣：05804_hatsumoude⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I go to a shrine on New Year's Day.

examples.japanese: {元旦|がんたん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦おせち{料理|りょうり}→おせち料理：26981_osechiryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: On the morning of New Year's Day, we eat osechi cuisine as a family.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年賀状|ねんがじょう}→年賀状：06227_nengajou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「{元旦|がんたん}」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一般的|いっぱんてき}→一般的：04784_ippanteki⟧だ。
examples.english: It is common to write "gantan" on New Year's cards.

notes:
{元旦|がんたん} strictly refers to the morning of January 1st, not the whole day. The character {旦|たん} depicts the sun rising above the horizon, representing dawn. However, in modern usage, many people use {元旦|がんたん} to refer to all of January 1st.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {元旦|がんたん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧ (New Year's morning)
- {元旦|がんたん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧ (to arrive on New Year's Day — said of cards)

RELATED WORDS:
⟦{元日|がんじつ}→元日：00059_ganjitsu⟧ refers to the entire day of January 1st. ⟦{正月|しょうがつ}→正月：01433_shougatsu⟧ refers to the broader New Year period (typically the first few days of January). On New Year's cards, {元旦|がんたん} is commonly printed as a closing mark, meaning "delivered on New Year's morning."
